# CECL Photonics / 中能芯光

> Official bilingual B2B website for photonic semiconductor components, optical modules, custom light engines and medical beauty OEM/ODM project development.

Canonical website: https://cecl-photonics-global.georgia52201.chatgpt.site/
Chinese homepage: https://cecl-photonics-global.georgia52201.chatgpt.site/zh

## Core capabilities

- AlGaInP red and yellow visible LED chip families
- InGaN blue and green visible LED chip families
- Infrared LED and VCSEL platforms
- LED arrays, COB engines, VCSEL modules and application-specific optical modules
- Medical beauty and personal-care light-engine development for wearable, handheld and professional device concepts
- OEM/ODM workflow covering requirement definition, architecture, prototype, validation planning, pilot build and production release

## Verification policy

Specifications, performance, reports and compliance evidence must be reviewed against the exact model, final device configuration and destination market. Component-level test reports must not be interpreted as blanket certification for a finished medical beauty device.
